'''Renau''' was a [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEGtW" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Renau was promoted to the rank of Moff and placed in command of the [[Eleventh Army]], also known as "Blazing Claw Command". The 11th Sector Army was charged with protecting the [[Gordian Reach Oversector]], an area that Renau effectively had complete power over.<ref name="TEGtW" />
